name: Katayama Kouichirou
source: Employee of Cho-Nippon Printing Company's Sales Department, Division #1. He was recently assigned to handling Heaven Publishing after his predecessor, Sachio Usui, was admitted to the hospital following a car crash earlier that day. He follows a strict deadline and pressures [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url] to submit the next edition of [I]Four-Star General Gossip[/I] to press earlier than planned.
translation: Employee of Cho-Nippon Printing Company's Sales Department, Division #1. He was recently assigned to handling Heaven Publishing after his predecessor, Sachio Usui, was admitted to the hospital following a car crash earlier that day. He follows a strict deadline and pressures [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url] to submit the next edition of [I]Four-Star General Gossip[/I] to press earlier than planned.
